# Orchestrator Alpha Flash API

High-speed autonomous settlement node providing live node status updates and node uptime metrics.

## Endpoint
- POST https://alpha-agent-brain.tartanu04.workers.dev

## Monetization
- This endpoint is locked via the x402 V2 protocol.
- Cost: 1000 atomic units of USDC ($0.001) on Base Mainnet.
